Produce a **build-ready design spec** for the InkOS Messages page rebuild. Working dir: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

Plan authority: `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/lets-build-whole-page-tender-petal.md` (approved). Audit PDF structure (7-channel rail + 3-pane + context panel + triage pills + smart chips + composer + internal notes + presence) is CORRECT and should be followed exactly for **layout / UX / behavior**. But the PDF's color palette (indigo bubbles, amber INQUIRY pills, green BOOKING pills, pink IG, indigo-50 unread rows, yellow internal notes) **VIOLATES InkOS brand**. Your job: re-map every color-bearing decision to the **locked 4-color system** (Bone / Onyx / Stone / Rust) while keeping structure 1:1 with the audit.

## Non-negotiable brand rules (project [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md))
1. Only 4 colors: Bone `#F7F7F5` · Onyx `#0F0F0F` · Stone `#787774` · Rust `#B23A2B`. No indigo, amber, green, pink, yellow. Ever.
2. Rust is earned — max 1-2 elements per viewport.
3. Onyx buttons carry workflow. Rust CTA reserved for destructive only.
4. Serif (Instrument Serif) for moments only (page title, empty-state names, italic accent).
5. No default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm|md|lg|xl|2xl`). Use `shadow-soft|card|card-hover|soft-md|lift|overlay`.
6. No raw hex in components — tokens from `app/globals.css` `@theme inline` only.
7. Stillness is the brand. No decorative motion. Context pane slide = 150ms. Thread switch = instant.

## What to produce

Create **`/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/messages-design-spec.md`** — a single build-ready spec document. Koda frontend will read this as the source of truth when building components.

The spec must cover ALL of the following with explicit tailwind class strings + component references that exist in this codebase:

### 1. Layout grid
- Desktop ≥1280px: `grid-cols-[72px_360px_minmax(0,1fr)_380px]` (channel rail 72px — tight, iconic — not 88px; matches icon-mode sidebar proportion). Context pane hides when `showContext=false` → `grid-cols-[72px_360px_minmax(0,1fr)]`.
- Tablet 768-1279px: 3-col w/ context pane as slide-over Sheet (use `components/ui/sheet.tsx`).
- Mobile <768px: stacked. URL param `?c=` drives swap. Rail as bottom nav chip row (horizontal scroll).
- Full height via existing `PageShell fullHeight` already in page.tsx. Each pane owns its own ScrollArea.

### 2. Channel Rail (left, 72px wide)
- Bone bg, Stone right border (`border-border`)
- 7 stacked channel buttons: All · SMS · Email · Instagram · WhatsApp · Web chat · Phone (bottom)
- Each button: 56px square, ghost style, centered icon (lucide 20px), label below in `text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] font-bold` (label token), small unread badge (Onyx pill, Bone text, absolute top-right)
- Active state: `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-rust)_10%,transparent)]` + icon color Rust + 2px Rust left accent bar (`before:` pseudo). Use token utility only — no raw hex.
- Hover (non-active): `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-onyx)_4%,transparent)]`
- Disconnected channels (IG/WhatsApp/WebChat/Phone until env wired): muted icon (Stone), no badge, tooltip "Connect provider" on hover. Clicking opens `ConnectChannelSheet`.
- Spec the exact icons: Inbox (All), MessageSquare (SMS), Mail (Email), Instagram (Instagram), MessageCircle (WhatsApp), Globe (Web chat), Phone (Phone).

### 3. Conversation List (center-left, 360px)
- Bone bg, Stone right border.
- Top: sticky header with filter pill row (All · Unread · Starred · Archived) + search input (focus `/` hotkey) matching existing `hooks/use-inbox-shortcuts.ts` pattern.
- Filter pills style: reuse existing `Button size="sm" variant="ghost"` w/ active variant = Onyx bg + Bone text.
- Search input: existing `Input` primitive, icon-left, "(/)" hint chip absolute-right rendered via `Badge variant="outline" size="sm"`.
- Below: scroll area of `ConversationListItem`s.
- **Row anatomy:**
  - Left: `Avatar` 40px + `AvatarBadge` (bottom-right) = tiny ChannelIcon colored Onyx on Bone circle (no pink/green — channel identified via icon shape only, all Onyx)
  - Center: line 1 bold name (`text-body font-semibold`) + timestamp right (`text-caption text-muted-foreground`), line 2 preview (`text-body-sm text-muted-foreground truncate`)
  - Right column: unread dot (4px Rust circle) ONLY when unread>0 + triage pill
- **Unread row background:** `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-rust)_3%,transparent)]` (very subtle — Rust earned but not loud). Name bold. NOT indigo.
- **Active row:** `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-onyx)_6%,transparent)]` + 2px Onyx left border (`border-l-2 border-primary`). NOT Rust left border unless row also has `missed_call` triage.
- Empty states dual pattern:
  - Zero database: serif heading "No messages yet." + sub-paragraph + CTAs (Onyx button "Share booking link", outline buttons "Connect Instagram" / "Connect WhatsApp")
  - Filter-zero: "No [channel] conversations" + Stone text + outline button "Clear filter"

### 4. Triage pill (TriageTagPill component)
Map to 4-color system (NO amber/green/indigo):
- `inquiry` → Rust-tinted pill: `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-rust)_12%,transparent)] text-[color:var(--color-rust)] border-transparent`, label "INQUIRY", uppercase, `text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.08em]`
- `booking` → Onyx-muted: `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-onyx)_8%,transparent)] text-foreground`, label "BOOKING"
- `client` → Stone-muted: `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-stone)_14%,transparent)] text-[color:var(--color-stone)]`, label "CLIENT"
- `deposit_paid` → Onyx-muted + small Rust dot inside: label "DEPOSIT PAID" + inline `w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[color:var(--color-rust)]`
- `rescheduling` → Onyx-muted + "↻" before label: label "RESCHEDULING"
- `pricing` → Rust-tinted w/ lighter %: `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-rust)_8%,transparent)] text-[color:var(--color-rust)]`, label "PRICING"
- `missed_call` → Rust-tinted stronger: `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-rust)_16%,transparent)] text-[color:var(--color-rust)]`, label "MISSED CALL"
Pill geometry: `px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md inline-flex items-center gap-1`.

### 5. Thread Panel
- Header bar: Bone bg, Stone bottom border, `h-14 px-4 flex items-center justify-between`.
  - Left: Avatar + client name (`text-h3`) + secondary row: triage pill + booking context ("Thu 2 PM · Miles V.") as Stone text.
  - Right: Assign button (existing AssignUserPicker adapted — render as outline button), Star toggle (icon button), Info toggle (opens/closes ContextPane, icon button with active onyx state when open), more-options dropdown.
- Message scroll area: Bone bg, natural padding, grouped by date (date separator = small Stone text + hairline Stone rule, centered).
- **MessageBubble** (NOT indigo):
  - Inbound: `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-onyx)_4%,transparent)] text-foreground` · rounded `rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm` · max-w-[72ch] · padding `px-4 py-2.5`
  - Outbound: `bg-[color:var(--color-onyx)] text-[color:var(--color-bone)]` · `rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm` · right-aligned
  - Auto-reply: inbound shape BUT `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-rust)_6%,transparent)] border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-rust)_30%,transparent)]` + caption "Auto-sent" in rust italic
  - Internal note: full-width, NOT aligned to a side. `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-stone)_12%,transparent)] border border-dashed border-[color:var(--color-stone)]` + "STAFF ONLY" label chip top-left in Stone. NOT yellow.
- Timestamp below each bubble: `text-caption text-muted-foreground`.
- Status icon inline on outbound: Check (sent), DoubleCheck (delivered — use `CheckCheck`), Eye (opened), AlertCircle (failed, Rust color).

### 6. PresenceStrip
Position: between messages list and smart-reply chips. `px-4 py-1.5 text-[13px] italic text-[color:var(--color-stone)] flex items-center gap-2`. Content: "Kaia is viewing" or "Kaia is typing…" with 3-dot typing pulse (Stone, stillness-respecting — single subtle pulse). Hidden when nobody else present.

### 7. SmartReplyChips
Position: above composer, sticky bottom area above it. Horizontal scroll row, chips:
- Style: `inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-border bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-onyx)_3%,transparent)] text-body-sm text-foreground hover:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-onyx)_8%,transparent)]`
- Prefix icon: Sparkles (Stone, `size-3.5`).
- Chip labels: context-dependent ("Reschedule to Fri 2 PM", "Check Fri availability", "Send aftercare guide", "Request deposit", "Share portfolio", "Send booking form link"). One line each, truncate at 28 chars with tooltip full text.
- Max 4 chips. Row scrolls horizontally. Use ScrollArea.

### 8. Composer
Bottom-docked in thread panel. Layout:
- Row 1 (tools bar): ChannelSwitcher (outline button with channel icon + label "SMS") · separator · Template `/` button (icon Command + "Templates") · Attach paperclip icon · Internal note toggle (StickyNote icon; when active: Stone-tinted bg + "Staff only" label visible) · Schedule send clock icon · flex-1 spacer · Send button (Onyx, disabled if empty)
- Row 2: Textarea (existing `Textarea` primitive, `min-h-[68px] max-h-[240px] resize-none field-sizing-content`)
- Internal note active → entire composer border + bg changes: `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-stone)_10%,transparent)] border-dashed border-[color:var(--color-stone)]` — visual affordance that what you type won't leave the studio. Send button label changes to "Save note".
- Keyboard: `⌘+Enter` send, `Esc` cancel internal-note mode, `/` opens TemplatePopover only when cursor at line-start and empty.

### 9. ContextPane (right, 380px)
Bone bg, Stone left border, ScrollArea. Sections in order (each uses `ContextSection` collapsible primitive — pattern like existing shadcn Accordion or Disclosure):
1. **Client profile** — Avatar 64px + name (h2 serif-italic if empty state, sans-bold normally) + tags (existing TagChip; max 3 + "+N more") + contact rows (phone, email, preferred channel) + "Open client profile →" link (ghost outline button).
2. **KPIs** — 3-col grid: LTV (`text-kpi`), Sessions count, No-shows. Stone labels uppercase `text-label`.
3. **Upcoming bookings** — list of up to 3. Each row: service name + date + artist + price, with inline Reschedule (ghost outline sm) + Cancel (ghost sm, destructive text-rust) buttons.
4. **Deposit status** — if latestPayment: "$X paid · MMM DD" + "Remaining $Y due at session" + "Request payment" outline button. If none: "No deposit on file · Request payment" outline button.
5. **Consent forms** — 3 rows (Consent / Medical / Photo release). Each: signed dot (Stone or Onyx) + label + date. Missing → "Resend" link.
6. **Reference images** — 3x3 grid of thumbnails from referenceImages[]. Click → existing lightbox or FullscreenGallery component. If none: Stone-italic "No reference images".
7. **Session history** — last 3 sessions, compact row (date + service + artist + price). "View all →" link to client page.
8. **Internal notes** — list of recent internal_note comms for this conversation. Inline "Add note" button opens composer with internal-note mode on.
9. **Quick actions** — 2-col grid of outline buttons: Reschedule booking · Request payment · Send consent form · Share portfolio · Create booking · Mark as VIP.

Section headers: `text-label` (uppercase, tracking-0.08em, Stone).
Shadows: `shadow-soft-md` on the pane when slid-over on tablet; none on desktop (hairline border suffices).

### 10. MessagesHeader (top bar inside PageShell)
- Flex row: serif italic "Messages" title (existing `PageHeader` is too big for 3-pane — use a compact 56px header: title + small "Unread · N" stone caption + right-side Settings gear icon + ShortcutCheatsheet `?` button.
- Replace existing `PageHeader` usage in page.tsx with compact version.

### 11. Shadows + elevation
- Rail, list, thread, context panes: no shadow, hairline Stone borders only.
- Template popover + ScheduleSend popover + Command menu: `shadow-lift` on Bone surface w/ Stone border.
- ConnectChannelSheet (ActionSheet-based): `shadow-overlay` on backdrop.
- Thread composer: no shadow; top hairline Stone border separates from messages.

### 12. Motion
- Context pane desktop = CSS grid column animating width via `transition-[grid-template-columns] duration-150 ease-out` on the parent grid OR inner pane `transition-transform translate-x-0 / translate-x-full duration-150`. Test both — pick whichever avoids reflow jank.
- Context pane tablet = Sheet default animation (already fine — Dialog-based slide).
- Typing 3-dots = 3 small circles, staggered opacity pulse `animate-pulse` Stone. Single cycle, not loud.
- No other animations.

### 13. Icon mapping (exhaustive)
Channel: SMS=MessageSquare, Email=Mail, Instagram=Instagram, WhatsApp=MessageCircle (lucide has no official WA logo; use circle), WebChat=Globe, Phone=Phone, All=Inbox.
Triage pill glyph: rescheduling="↻" unicode, deposit_paid=small Rust dot span, others=none (text only).
Status: Clock (queued), Check (sent), CheckCheck (delivered), Eye (opened), AlertCircle (failed, Rust), Paperclip (attach), Sparkles (smart reply chip), Command (templates `/`), StickyNote (internal), Clock/CalendarClock (schedule send), Send (send), Star (star), Archive (archive), MoreVertical (more), Info (info/context toggle), Search (search), X (close), ArrowLeft (mobile back).

### 14. Empty states copy
Keep InkOS brand voice (editorial, quiet):
- Rail zero-conversations (in list pane): serif italic "No messages yet." + body "Conversations arrive here the moment a client texts, emails, or DMs you." + CTA row.
- Filter zero: "No [channel] conversations" (no serif — data result) + Stone + outline "Clear filter" button.
- Context pane w/o open conversation: Bone, centered serif italic "Select a conversation." + Stone caption.
- Disconnected channel state (ConnectChannelSheet): serif italic "Connect Instagram." + editorial paragraph + Onyx "Connect via Meta" button (stub disabled with tooltip "Provider credentials coming soon").

### 15. What to reuse vs build new
Reuse: `PageShell`, `ScrollArea`, `Avatar`, `AvatarBadge`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `Tooltip`, `Popover`, `Command` (cmdk), `ActionSheet` (for ConnectChannelSheet + ScheduleSendPopover's sheet-fallback on mobile), `Separator`, `TagChip`, `AssignUserPicker`.
Build new: ChannelRail, ConversationList (refactor ThreadList), ConversationListItem, ThreadPanel refactor, MessageBubble, PresenceStrip, SmartReplyChips, Composer refactor, TemplatePopover, ScheduleSendPopover, ChannelSwitcher, ContextPane, ContextSection, TriageTagPill, ChannelIcon, EmptyRail, ConnectChannelSheet, ShortcutCheatsheet, MessagesHeader.

### 16. Hooks
Fork `hooks/use-inbox-shortcuts.ts` → `hooks/messages/use-messages-shortcuts.ts` with bindings: `/`=focus search, `j`=next thread, `k`=prev thread, `r`=focus composer, `a`=open assign, `e`=archive active, `!`=toggle star, `n`=toggle internal-note, `?`=cheatsheet, `Esc`=close context pane / exit internal-note.

### 17. Responsive breakpoints (explicit)
- `≥1280px`: 4 columns visible (when context open), 3 when closed
- `1024-1279px`: 3 columns, context pane becomes Sheet
- `768-1023px`: rail + list visible, thread becomes route target via `?c=`; context pane Sheet
- `<768px`: single pane stacked, rail becomes scrollable horizontal strip at top, list OR thread based on `?c=`

### 18. Accessibility
- Every icon button has `aria-label`
- Pane landmarks: `<nav aria-label="Channels">`, `<section aria-label="Conversations">`, `<section aria-label="Conversation thread">`, `<aside aria-label="Client context">`
- Color contrast: Rust on Bone = 4.5:1 (verified). Stone text on Bone must stay ≥4.5:1 — use `text-[color:var(--color-stone)]` which maps to `#787774` on `#F7F7F5` = 4.67:1. Compliant.
- Focus rings: existing shadcn focus-visible ring — keep.
- Keyboard: every action reachable. Shortcut cheatsheet discoverable via `?`.

## Deliverables
1. Write the full spec to `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/messages-design-spec.md`
2. Include per-component anatomy with exact tailwind class strings (ready-to-paste), props interface in TS, and behavior notes
3. Include one ASCII layout diagram showing desktop + tablet + mobile
4. Explicit "What NOT to do" list citing the PDF's brand-violating choices and the InkOS-correct replacement
5. Under the "Token utilities" section, document these helpers to use in classes: 
   - `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-onyx)_4%,transparent)]` pattern
   - `text-[color:var(--color-rust)]` pattern
   - Document which existing utilities (`bg-accent`, `bg-muted`, `border-border`) map to which token so Koda picks semantic shadcn utility first, raw color-mix second
6. Mark the spec version: "InkOS Messages v1 · Design Spec v1.0 · 2026-04-23 · Vega approved"

Do NOT build any components. Your output is a design contract. Koda frontend reads your spec and builds.

1	# InkOS Messages — 3-Pane Omnichannel Inbox v1
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Audit PDF (`InkOS_Messages_Page_Audit.pdf`) validated three strategic calls: **omnichannel inbox (7 channels, 1 view)**, **auto-triage (Inquiry / Booking / Client tags + conditional auto-reply)**, **always-on context panel (client + bookings + deposits + consent + quick actions)**. No tattoo SaaS combines Mangomint's conversation-state depth + Inkedin's 5-channel consolidation + InkDesk's client-context sidebar + LucentDesk's auto-reply triage. InkOS owns that wedge.
6	
7	Current `/messages` surface is 2-pane (ThreadList + ThreadPanel) + client context card inline. SMS (Twilio) and Email (Resend) work end-to-end. `conversations` + `client_communications` schema, RPCs (`find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`), Realtime hooks (`useRealtimeMessages`, `useRealtimeConversationList`), and BullMQ send-sms worker already exist.
8	
9	Rebuild `/messages` into **3-pane + slide-in 4th context pane**, add triage tagging, auto-reply engine, smart reply chips (rule-based, AI-hook clean), composer power features, assignment + typing presence, internal notes, templates library, schedule send, and mass blast entry point. Ship SMS + Email fully working; Instagram / WhatsApp / Web chat / Voice = UI shell + stub webhook routes + schema-ready (flip env to activate when creds land).
10	
11	Outcome: front desk clears 14 DMs in 12 min. No inquiry falls through. Every reply is informed. Artists never open Instagram for work again.
12	
13	---
14	
15	## Scope
16	
17	### v1 — ships this build
18	- 3-pane layout (channel rail + conversation list + thread panel) + toggleable context pane
19	- 7-channel rail (SMS, Email, Instagram, WhatsApp, Web chat, Phone, All) — SMS + Email fully working; others render channel + "Connect provider" empty state when unconfigured
20	- Auto-triage tags: `inquiry | booking | client | rescheduling | pricing | deposit_paid | missed_call` (rule-based, deterministic)
21	- Auto-reply engine for new-sender inquiries (studio-editable template, tone preference)
22	- Smart reply chips — keyword + context-derived, render below thread
23	- Composer: `/`-trigger templates, internal-note toggle, schedule send, channel switcher, attach-from-library
24	- Context pane: client profile + upcoming bookings + deposit + consent + reference gallery + internal notes + 6 quick actions
25	- Assign conversation to team member (reuses existing `conversations.assigned_to`)
26	- Typing + viewing presence (Supabase Realtime presence — no new table)
27	- Internal note bubbles (yellow, staff-only, `is_internal_note=true`)
28	- Empty states dual pattern (zero-state w/ CTAs vs filter-zero)
29	- Keyboard shortcuts: `/` search · `j/k` nav · `r` reply · `a` assign · `e` archive · `!` star · `n` internal · `?` cheatsheet · `⌘+Enter` send
30	- Settings → Messaging page (auto-reply rules, template CRUD, tone, signature)
31	- Feature-gate `omnichannel_inbox` (Studio+) wired dual-layer
32	
33	### v2 — explicitly out of scope (stubbed)
34	- Meta Graph API inbound (Instagram DM) — webhook route scaffold + handler noop
35	- Meta WhatsApp Cloud API inbound — webhook route scaffold + handler noop
36	- Web chat widget + ingest route
37	- Twilio Voice ingest + voicemail transcripts
38	- Inbound email webhook (Postmark / Resend inbound)
39	- AI-generated smart replies (Anthropic) — `lib/messaging/triage.ts` has single `generateSmartReplies(ctx)` adapter; rule-impl v1, AI-impl v2
40	- Full-text search index on `client_communications.body`
41	- Mass message blast composer (entry point added; existing `components/reach/BatchImportSheet` composes the blast path in later sprint)
42	
43	---
44	
45	## Architecture
46	
47	### URL model
48	Switch master-detail from path-based `/messages/[conversationId]` → query-param `/messages?c=<id>&channel=<c>&filter=<f>`. Enables full 3-pane w/ shallow routing (preserves scroll state + channel + filter). Mobile still drills down via conditional render. **Delete** `app/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/` dir.
49	
50	### Pane layout
51	CSS Grid — no resizable library (none in codebase):
52	```
53	grid-template-columns: 88px 360px 1fr 380px;
54	                       ^rail  ^list  ^thread ^context (collapsible)
55	```
56	`ContextPane` toggles via button in thread header; when closed, thread panel expands. Mobile: single pane w/ stack nav.
57	
58	### Data flow
59	- Page = Server Component. Reads initial conversation list + active thread + active messages + active client bookings in parallel (already correct in `page.tsx`).
60	- Client state: filter/search/channel/open-conversation-id → URL searchParams (Next 16 native).
61	- Mutations → Server Actions (`app/(app)/messages/actions.ts`) → return `ActionResult<T>`.
62	- Writes to audit-critical tables (`client_communications`, `conversations`) = Supabase client `.update/.insert` OR RPC where trigger consolidates (existing `find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`).
63	- Live updates via existing `useRealtimeConversationList` (list pane) + `useRealtimeMessages` (thread pane) + new `useConversationPresence` (typing/viewing badge).
64	
65	---
66	
67	## Database layer — Dato
68	
69	### New migration: `20260423100000_messages_v1_triage_templates.sql`
70	1. **`conversations` ALTER:**
71	   - `triage_tag text CHECK (triage_tag IN ('inquiry','booking','client','rescheduling','pricing','deposit_paid','missed_call'))` nullable
72	   - `resolved_at timestamptz` nullable (auto-close pattern from Mangomint)
73	   - `last_auto_reply_at timestamptz` nullable (debounces re-fires)
74	   - Index: `idx_conversations_studio_triage (studio_id, triage_tag)` for filter
75	2. **`client_communications` ALTER:**
76	   - `is_internal_note boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
77	   - `scheduled_for timestamptz` nullable (for schedule-send queued messages)
78	   - `reply_to_message_id uuid` nullable (threading future-use)
79	   - Partial index: `idx_comms_scheduled (scheduled_for) WHERE scheduled_for IS NOT NULL AND status = 'queued'` — worker polls
80	3. **New `message_templates`:**
81	   - Columns: `id, studio_id, name, slug, body, channel ('sms'|'email'|'both'), category ('aftercare'|'deposit'|'booking'|'portfolio'|'reschedule'|'inquiry_reply'|'custom'), trigger_keywords text[], is_default boolean, created_by, created_at, updated_at`
82	   - Unique: `(studio_id, slug)`
83	   - Indexes: `(studio_id, category)`, `(studio_id) WHERE is_default=true`
84	   - RLS: studio_members active member = SELECT; owner/admin = all INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE; artist/receptionist = INSERT/UPDATE own (`created_by = auth.uid()`)
85	   - Seed default templates per studio via trigger on `studios` INSERT (or via onboarding action)
86	4. **New `auto_reply_rules`:**
87	   - Columns: `id, studio_id, trigger_type ('new_inquiry'|'missed_call'|'deposit_paid'|'keyword'), keyword text?, template_id uuid REFERENCES message_templates, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, cooldown_minutes int DEFAULT 60, tone ('casual'|'formal') DEFAULT 'casual', created_at, updated_at`
88	   - Unique: `(studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)` (nulls distinct for single-trigger rules)
89	   - RLS: studio_members SELECT; owner/admin ALL
90	5. **New RPC `triage_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid) RETURNS text`:**
91	   - Loads conv + latest inbound message + client (if any) + upcoming bookings
92	   - Applies deterministic rules (spec in "Triage rules" below)
93	   - Updates `conversations.triage_tag`
94	   - Returns applied tag
95	   - `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`
96	6. **New RPC `enqueue_auto_reply(p_conversation_id uuid, p_rule_id uuid) RETURNS uuid`:**
97	   - Reads rule → template → renders (w/ `{{studio_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`)
98	   - Inserts `client_communications` row (direction=outbound, status=queued, body=rendered)
99	   - Sets `conversations.last_auto_reply_at = now()`
100	   - Worker picks up queued row and dispatches via Twilio/Resend
101	   - Returns new comm id
102	7. **Rollback block** at top of file (standard Dato pattern).
103	8. Regenerate types: `pnpm db:types`.
104	
105	### Triage rules (pure SQL in RPC, no LLM)
106	```
107	IF sender not in clients table            → inquiry
108	ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_reschedule → rescheduling + booking
109	ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_pricing    → pricing + inquiry
110	ELIF client has upcoming booking (next 7d)       → booking
111	ELIF client has payment event metadata.kind='deposit_paid' in last 24h → deposit_paid
112	ELSE                                              → client
113	```
114	Keyword lists constants — `kw_reschedule = ['reschedule','move','change','switch','shift']`, `kw_pricing = ['price','how much','quote','cost','rate']`, `kw_missed_call` handled in webhook path.
115	
116	---
117	
118	## Server layer — Koda
119	
120	### Updates
